designPrompt: A young woman in her twenties with a warm, friendly storybook-reading voice. Clear American (US) accent. Medium speaking pace. Gentle, expressive, patient, calm and clear - perfect for reading picture books aloud to young children.
specimen: Good morning, little friend. Shall we spend a quiet hour with a story? Outside, the garden is bright and still, and somewhere a kettle is just beginning to hum. Take your time settling in. There is no hurry at all today.
